sentences.text:
The applicant was found involved in Case Crime No.0141 of 2019 under Sections 376, 420 and
506 Ipc, Police Station Mahila, District Hardoi.

2. Ms. Ankita Tripathi, learned A.G.A. has produced the status of trial, whereby trial pending has
been decided by the District and Sessions Judge/ F.T.C., Hardoi, in which the applicant has been
acquitted vide judgment and order dated 4.12.2023, the report is taken on record.
3.  In view of the above, this bail application has become infructuous.
Accordingly, the same is rejected as having been rendered infructuous.

(Irshad Ali,J.) September 4, 2025 Gautam  Sobaran Second Bail vs State Of U.P. on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6507930/
